# Sex_Network_Interaction

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The statistical interaction effect between biological sex and specific brain network modules (e.g., default mode, salience) on connectome topology. Reveals that network-specific topological variations are not uniform across sexes, informing how neuromorphic architectures might need sex-aware design parameters.
